mitchellkrogza_phishing.name: Mitchell Krogza Phishing.Database
mitchellkrogza_phishing.description: Continuous automated repository of live, active verified phishing URLs and malicious domains.
mitchellkrogza_phishing.preprocessing: URL parsing, scheme normalization, whitespace stripping, domain extraction, deduplication.

openphish_feed.name: OpenPhish Community Feed
openphish_feed.description: Autonomous zero-day phishing feed identifying active brand impersonation and credential phishing.
openphish_feed.preprocessing: Validation of URL format, scheme normalization, domain extraction, deduplication.

tranco_top_1m.name: Tranco Research Top 1M Domains
tranco_top_1m.description: Hardened top 1M ranking of the web's most visited and verified legitimate domains (Pochat et al., NDSS 2019).
tranco_top_1m.preprocessing: Top tier domain selection (ranks 1-20000), protocol synthesis (https://), subpage synthesis, deduplication.

uci_sms_spam.name: UCI SMS Spam Collection
uci_sms_spam.description: Benchmark mobile message corpus categorized into legitimate ham and unsolicited spam.
uci_sms_spam.preprocessing: Tab-delimited text extraction, encoding normalization, label mapping, duplicate removal.

huggingface_phishing_email.name: HuggingFace Phishing Email Dataset
huggingface_phishing_email.description: Consolidated corpus of safe emails and phishing attacks derived from SpamAssassin, Nazario, and Enron collections.
huggingface_phishing_email.preprocessing: CSV row cleaning, NaN body handling, header stripping, length truncation (1000 chars), label mapping.

cert_in_i4c_curated_threats.name: CERT-In & I4C Documented Threat Patterns
cert_in_i4c_curated_threats.description: Reviewed modern Indian cyber fraud patterns: Digital Arrests, Hinglish OTP theft, Electricity bill disconnection, Part-time Telegram tasks, Fake loan app extortion.
cert_in_i4c_curated_threats.preprocessing: Pattern normalization, syntax deduplication, human expert review.

npci_upi_curated_payments.name: NPCI UPI Corporate Handles & Documented Payment Fraud Vectors
npci_upi_curated_payments.description: Verified official merchant VPAs and banking handles vs known fraudulent reverse-collect lures, lottery fees, and QR code traps.
npci_upi_curated_payments.preprocessing: VPA validation, canonical string structuring, duplicate removal.
